note: Scholarship platforms: one adapter per platform reaches every organization hosted on it. 'verified' records what was actually tested on checkedAt; anything not listed there is from memory and unconfirmed.

platforms.name: AcademicWorks (Blackbaud Award Management)
platforms.structure: HTML table: award amount, title link (/opportunities/{id}), deadline or 'Ended'. Paginated with ?page=N.
platforms.verified: Listing parsed on ucsd, ou and csulb. The signed-out view showed few awards per school (26, 2, 1), mostly 'Ended'; whether more appear when signed in is not confirmed.

platforms.name: ScholarshipUniverse (CampusLogic / Ellucian)
platforms.structure: Not inspected. From memory: JavaScript app, usually behind student single sign-on, sometimes with a public catalog.
platforms.verified: Only that arizona.scholarshipuniverse.com responds and unknown names do not resolve. Page contents not read.

platforms.name: AwardSpring
platforms.structure: Not inspected. From memory: sign-in first, with a public list of awards on some portals.
platforms.verified: Only that unknown names do not resolve. Page contents not read.

platforms.name: CommunityForce
platforms.verified: Only that unknown names do not resolve.

platforms.name: STARS Online (Scholarship Tracking and Review System)
platforms.verified: Only that unknown names do not resolve. No portal found in the 300-school trial, so the pattern itself may be wrong.

platforms.name: Scholarship America
platforms.structure: One page per program with status, deadline with time zone, eligibility list, awards and required documents. Apply button leads to a saiapply.org portal.
platforms.verified: Sitemap lists 398 programs. Burger King and Amazon Future Engineer pages were read in full and share one layout.

platforms.name: Kaleidoscope
platforms.structure: Not inspected. One shared catalog site rather than a portal per organization.

platforms.name: SmarterSelect
platforms.structure: Not inspected. Root redirects to a sign-in page; program pages are reached by direct link from the organization's own site.
platforms.verified: Only that app.smarterselect.com redirects to app.ui3.smarterselect.com/login.

platforms.name: Foundant (Scholarship Lifecycle Manager / GLM)
platforms.unknownNameBehavior: Returns 200 even for an unknown key, so it cannot be probed by status code
platforms.structure: Not inspected. Sign-in page per organization; keys must be collected from each foundation's own site.
platforms.verified: Only the behavior for an unknown key.

platforms.name: ISTS (International Scholarship and Tuition Services)
platforms.structure: Not inspected. Root is a sign-in page. Hosts the Elks Most Valuable Student application.
platforms.verified: Only that the root redirects to a log-on page.

platforms.name: Common App / Common App for Transfer
platforms.structure: Scholarship is added as a 'school' inside the application. Not crawlable; the provider's own site is the source.

platforms.name: Submittable, SurveyMonkey Apply (smapply), FluidReview
platforms.structure: General application tools, not scholarship-specific, so a matching name does not imply scholarships. Regeneron STS uses smapply.
